entrypoints.name: range
postconditions: The returned list is finite and non-empty.
Its first element is first and its last element is last.
If first <= last, it contains exactly first, first + 1, ..., last in strictly increasing order.
If first > last, it contains exactly first, first - 1, ..., last in strictly decreasing order.
Endpoints are inclusive; range n n = [n].
Ordering and multiplicity are observable and mandatory.

excluded_behavior: No randomness, effects, mutable state, I/O, strings, floats, options, exceptions as normal results, or infinite/coinductive streams.
No set-only, length-only, unordered, deduplicated, or finite-sample weakening.
